protocol.title: validation-selected zero-Probe retention checkpoint
protocol.status: one new formation-reliability hypothesis frozen before new training
protocol.hypothesis: The fixed final 750-step checkpoint is an unstable retention endpoint; a preregistered large-panel selection among fixed zero-Probe maintenance checkpoints will generalize to a protected test without changing training.
protocol.single_change_from_Level_7_1: checkpoint selection during the unchanged 750-step zero-Probe maintenance trajectory

checkpoint_selection.ranking: highest validation query, then later zero-Probe step
checkpoint_selection.no_eligible_candidate: do not open protected test; record retention-selection failure

registered_classification.strong_stable_causal_formation: both seeds pass selection, protected behavior, and causal gates
registered_classification.conditional_stable_causal_formation: exactly one seed passes all gates and the other fails before causal opening
registered_classification.causal_gate_failed: a seed passes protected behavior but fails the causal audit
registered_classification.retention_checkpoint_selection_failed: no seed passes the protected behavior gate after registered selection
registered_classification.formation_curriculum_failed: neither seed reaches the candidate trajectory

protocol.stop_rule: record the registered outcome; do not add a candidate, rerun the protected test, extend training, or replace a seed

diagnosis.registered_stop_boundary: Do not add candidates, rerun protected data, extend training, replace a seed, repair an output head/router, or open seed909.
